presented_options.B: path parameters (e.g. /users/:id) are captured and made available to the handler through a typed params map

presented_options.A: waits indefinitely until every in-flight request completes, then exits with code 0
presented_options.B: aborts immediately on SIGTERM, replying 503 to all in-flight connections, then exits non-zero

presented_options.D: exits with code 1 because at least one request was still in flight when the timeout elapsed

answers.rationale: Default graceful_timeout_s is 30; after SIGTERM the server waits ~30 seconds then exits 0, abandoning the two handlers that need 60 seconds.
